Name: Company Club

Description:
It was May 1994 when the Circolo Arcigay Company Club opened in Milan.
In the area, the need was felt for a pub styled gay venue, open all week long and in the hours of the evening and night.
Early, the venue got a foothold thanks to its style that is not changed at all throughout the years. Habitues of Company Club prefer a sober and masculine style, far away from frivolousness and platitude often associated with the homosexual world.
Due to the professionalism of the administrators and the staff, over time, the Company Club has been able to offer an excellent bar service and music projets each time innovative and interesting, it has offered severals initiatives such as themed nights dedicates the the "leather" and "bear" worlds. Here, the activity of one of the most important Italian bear group took place. It has also suggested cultural initiatives, such as painting and photographs exhibitions, social and political debates, without forgetting the charity by a committed relationship with A.S.A (Aids Solidarity Association) and with Arci and Arcigay.
13 years later, the club gets a new image that aims to create new projects and new ideas so as to keep alive the tradition of the venue up to a more international dimension, asserting itself as a focus for its public.

Rich

You gotta love 'em!

Description:
Club 5 is Madison's Premiere LGBT Nightclub. Club 5 has become deeply rooted within the Madison community over the past decade and continues to be the best LGBTQA nightclub in Madison and the surrounding area.

Located just off the Hwy12/18 beltline, Club 5 offers easy access and a large parking lot for the diverse crowds it attracts.

Club 5 is more than a nightclub to most of its regular attendees. Club 5 is a place to be yourself, whether that be barracksgay, straight, bi, transgendered, black, white or whatever; you can feel free to be it. Club 5 strives to be a place of acceptance and discovery. It is a place you may come to meet friends and even make new ones. Over the past decade the music has changed; the boys and girls are older, and yet new club goers continue to discover Club 5.
gbar

Under new ownership after the passing of Club 5 founder Ed Grunewald in April, 2008, the staff has recommitted themselves. Club 5 received Madison's Favorite Nightclub Award in 2008. The addition of the new women's bar (The G.Bar) in the fall of 2008 now provides club goers with three different venues under the same roof in addition to the huge outdoor patio and stage. The staff , not willing to rest on past laurels, has begun working on the club's newest upgrade and remodeling of its main bar and dance floor over the Summer of 2009.

The sound, the lights, the theme parties, the energy, the happy hour events, the house DJ's and the staff you can call family help make Club 5 what it is today. We are dedicated to creating an even better nightclub experience worthy of your expectations. Stop in and visit us soon....we can't wait to meet you.

Description:
The Heretic is my kind of bar. Nothing fancy, it's got a dark, dungeon-like atmosphere attracting bears, leathermen and musclemen.

It has several bar stations located throughout the place; (usually all open on busy weekend nights). It's got cavernous halls and a cruisy back room, as well as a large outdoor multi-level patio. There's a DJ booth, and the dance floor gets hot and frisky! There's also a pool table, and an ATM machine.

The dance floor opens at 10:00pm, and they have a cover charge after 11:00pm. Be sure to check out the leather shop for a selection of leather, sex toys and more. (The shop is open on Wed, Thurs and Fri from 10:30pm till 3:00am).

Do NOT show up in flipflops ? You won't get in the door! (Open-toed / open-heeled shoes are not permitted).

There's free parking in the front and in the rear lower level lot, but on weekends after 10:00pm you?ll be hard pressed to find a spot. If so, be prepared to park further down the block. If you need a cab, ask the friendly staff, they?ll be happy to call one for you.

Say hi to Paul and Badboy Brian, two of the friendliest bartenders in all of HOTlanta!

Name: Roxx Tavern And Grill
Address: 1824 Cheshire Bridge Rd NE, Atlanta, GA 30324
Description:
A gay dining destination for those visiting HOTlanta, and a favorite amongst local bears is Roxx Tavern And Grill. Lunch, dinner or Sunday brunch, you can't go wrong with anything you choose from the menu, be it Green Fried Tomatoes, burgers with Elvis pickles, steaks, Buffalo or BBQ chicken fingers, and one of the best Cod fish sandwiches around. They have an awesome selection of beers on draft, including some of my favorites from Atlanta's very own Sweetwater Brewery. (Try the "420" - You'll love it!)

Yeah, their salads are also good, but their menu is best known for the hearty tasty meals that bears love to eat. Be sure to leave room for dessert.

At Roxx you have a choice of dinning inside or out on their nice patio, and they have plenty of free parking. We had good service every time my partner and I went there.  You're always made to feel welcome. We also found their prices reasonable, and their portions generous.

Description:
Cowtippers is a favorite steak house amongst the Bear Atlanta gay community. Located in Midtown, not far from Piedmont Park, and a block away from MIXX, Burkharts and Felix, it's a no nonsense kind of restaurant where you can get a good steak, great appetizers, salads, desserts, and of course, stiff cocktails, and be yourself amongst the company of friends and friendly staff.

Their motto is: "Let us put something good in your mouth" Now, how can you go wrong with that?!?

Be sure to join their Loyalty Program for many extra benefits, including special freebies and point offerings and notifications to their special events.

They have free parking.

Name: Atlanta Eagle
Address: 1492 Piedmont Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30309
Description:
As is true with all Eagle bars around the world, here too you'll find a crowd that is masculine, and a bit on the hard-core side. Here you're more likely to find a Bear or Muscle/Leather daddy type smoking a cigar while enjoying the surroundings, than you are finding pretty twinks or drag queens dolled up for a night out on the town.

Eagle Atlanta, low attitude, or as they say, "Atlanta-tude". Hardcore, yet not too hardcore, and definitely Southern welcoming. So come on out if you're a masculine, laid-back, fun-loving guy. Check out their calendar for special theme weekends, and come visit!

Saturdays are great! There's weekly S&M, leather and bear club meetings.

Name: Burkharts Pub
Address: 1492 Piedmont Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30309
Description:
Burkharts features itself as being one of Atlanta's favorite gay bars. The atmosphere here is comfortable and relaxed. When you first walk in you kind of get the feeling that you're stepping into an old chalet, with tall ceilings, a stone fireplace and all. (You almost expect to see mounted game hanging from the walls.)

There are several (4) bars both upstairs and downstairs. There's pinball, pool tables, video game machines, Blackjack. They also have a great patio that stretches across the entire back side of the bar, with intimate quiet areas where you can have a nice relaxed conversation with a friend, or meet and better get to know a new one.

They have daily food specials, and you can get a good steak dinner at a reasonable price. Food is served Mon through Fri up to 10 PM, and Sun up to 8 PM.

Not a Bear bar per se, it attracts a mixed crowd, and overall the guys here are friendly, approachable and laid-back.  You'll have a good time!

Be sure to say hi to Anthony, one of the sexiest and friendliest bartenders in town, and ask him to make you one of his mean double espresso vodka drinks!

Name: MIXX Atlanta
Address: 1492 Piedmont Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30309
Description:
Located in the Ansley Square mall near the intersection of Piedmont and Monroe, (about half a mile from the Atlanta Botanical Gardens and Piedmont Park), is MIXX Atlanta, the newest gay bar to open in town.

MIXX offers nonsmoking and smoking areas, indoor/outdoor bars, patio and dance floor.

Check out their BEAR COCKTAIL HOUR from 4:00 to 9:30 on Thursdays, (with FREE PIZZA at 7 pm!) On Tuesdays they offer a Movie Night, (free popcorn and all). They also have a Comedy night on Wednesdays.

Be sure to say hi to Brian and Kevin, two of the sexiest, friendliest best bartenders in town!

Name: Joe's On Juniper
Address: 1049 Juniper St NE, Atlanta, GA 30309
Description:
Joe's On Juniper is a Gay popular, (hetero-friendly), tavern in Midtown's gayborhood, about half a mile from Piedmont Park. This bar-and-grill serves a wide array of traditional American foods, along with a great selection of beers from around the world. (More than 30 beers on draft, plus over 100 bottled ones). Treat yourself to their brunch on Saturdays and Sundays, and enjoy one of their Champagne cocktails.

Joe's has the best Buffalo hot wings in town, (made with Anchor wing sauce, the hot sauce from Buffalo, NY that made Buffalo wings famous!) Also try their calamari, and wide array of salads including Cobb and spicy shrimp. BTW, you can't go wrong with their massive, mouth-watering delicious Angus burgers. Their Coca-Colas are served in gigantic thirst-quenching cups. (After all, Coca Cola was invented in Atlanta, and is home to its world headquarters).

A favorite amongst local Bears, on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday nights they feature trivia.  A great place to grab a pitcher of beer and have a blast amongst friends. All in all Joe's is a great choice for lunch, dinner or late night snacking. Check out their patio, frequently voted one of Atlanta's favorite outdoor dining spots.

Service is always Southern friendly, with Nathan the sexy manager always on hand to make sure everyone is having a great time.

Name: Mary’s

Creative Loafing readers voted Mary’s as Atlanta’s Best Gay Bar and Best Karaoke for five years in a row. The Logo channel says that Mary’s is the Best Gay Bar in America. Out magazine calls Mary’s one of the Top 50 Gay Bars In The World.

Why does everyone always talk about Mary’s? Known for our hip and fun vibe, visit us and you’ll meet new people you won’t find other places. We have weekly and monthly special events, the city's best karaoke (with more than 15,000 songs available) and a host of skilled DJs with the best music and videos. Description:
Yin Yang Night Club is a family owned business. We pride ourselves on welcoming everyone to our establishment. Our number one priority is giving you the best  experience possible and leave you wanting more!
 
Our incredible drag shows start at 9:30 pm every Thursday and Saturday night and are followed by DJ Muffie, spinning today's hits, and some throwback favorites! Come enjoy a fabulous show filled with some of the best “Drag Queens” in the Midwest that are sure to entertain and keep you laughing all evening long.
 
Combined with the friendliest staff in Columbia’s night life scene, our signature cocktails, drink specials and one of a kind dance floor, and modern lighting and sound system are sure to keep you coming back again and again.
 
Yin Yang Night Club hosts special events every Friday so check our calendar for upcoming special events that will tickle your fancy no matter what your ‘desires’ may be! When you walk into the Phoenix, there is no mistaking that this is the gathering place for the leather community of New Orleans. Besides the hot crowd, the posters of leather bars from around the world that hang from the walls are a sure give away. If you need information about the leather community or special events in New Orleans, the Phoenix is the right place. The locals and the bartenders will be sure to lead you in the right direction.

The Phoenix is one of the largest bars in the city occupying a two story house on historic Elysian Fields- just a short walk from the French Quarter.

Downstairs is the main bar where you'll find a competitive pool table. Past the main bar and through the back doors is the courtyard where beer busts take place. Upstairs is the New Orleans Eagle. The Eagle features music and a particularly heavy cruising atmosphere.

If you need those boots polished, stop by the Phoenix on a Friday night for a really good spit and shine. The Phoenix also sells a great collection of T-shirts.

The Phoenix has been Gay owned and operated over 25 years. Bobby Connell bought the club in August 2005, shortly before Hurricane Katrina. It's better then ever now, so come see the exciting changes made by Bobby.

It has hosted and still continues to host many charitable events throughout the year including: The Easter Basket Auction, TGRA functions, Turtle Creek Choral events, PSSA and DIVA specials, Mr. and Miss Pageants, Texas AIDS Bike Ride, Broadway Cares events, our own employee turn-about shows, Razzle Dazzle Dallas support, Court Shows, cook outs, The Denim Party, The Texas Flag coin toss collecting cash during the Pride Parade, Home for the Holidays, The Christmas Stocking Auction, and our original Rent-A-Cowboy benefiting various community organizations. The Round Up raises over $120,000.00 per year for Dallas charities, thanks to our caring employees and generous customers!

On February 23, 1989 A six alarm fire started to cover up a burglary in an adjacent office destroyed the Old Round Up Saloon as we know it today. Within days the staff and friends had relocated to the legendary "Tex's Ranch" on Maple avenue. Construction began immediately to rebuild the Bar at it's old location. Painstaking efforts were made to recreate the Bar. The only thing left from the fire were three chandeliers and the front door.

Rumor has it that this location once served as major bookmaking operation, and later was the home of the famed "Old Warsaw Restaurant" It is still rumored today that Mrs. Slavick's ghost still haunts the Saloon and loves C&W music. Just ask your favorite bartender about some of the stories as there are to many to tell here.

In May, 1998, the Round Up was purchased by Gary Miller and Alan Pierce. You may have noticed a lot of changes. We've made several improvements to the club, added credit cards, a premium Tequila Shack, The Loft, The Tool Shed, covered the patio, reopened the Day Bar( now called the Parlor.) And we ain't done yet!!!! Watch for ever changing and improving the joint. Be assured that The Round Up will ALWAYS be a clean and friendly atmosphere, where you can kick up your heels and feel at home in the COUNTRY!!

(You still get the feeling you're in a dark, smoky shaft). It also remains as popular (and as cruisy) as ever, and still offers some of the best dance music and sexy dancers in the area.

In addition to the dance floor where DJs spin classical disco hits as well as the latest mixes, the new location has pool tables, a patio out back with tables and chairs where you can chat or just relax. All in all TMC has retained its charm. It's a friendly place to party and dance the night away, or just relax and watch sexy dancers strut their stuff.

Name: Pecs
Address: 2046 University Ave, San Diego, CA 92104
Description:
Open Monday- Saturday 12pm-2am, Sunday 10am-2am.

WOOF! Bear Night - The SECOND WEDNESDAY of each month!

Monday Night: Brian and Gunther Present SIN (Service Industry Night).  If you work in the biz or if you just like great deals on drinks and beer you'll want to come in on Monday nights for sure.  From 9pm to close we've got deeply discounted prices on ALL Beer and on our Well Drinks. $2.75-$3.75 beers, $9.50/$10.50 Pitchers, $4.25 Wells, and to top that all off our pool tables are open and free all the while.  These specials are for anyone so come on in!


Tuesday Night: Brian and Bob Present Bottled Beer Tuesdays.  If you're a beer person tonight is your night.  All of our bottled domestics are only $2.25 from 9pm to close.  We're talking Bud Light, Coors Light, MGD and more!  We also have ALL of our premium bottled beer for $3.25!  Yes, that means our awesome craft beers like the Ballast Point Sculpin and Stone IPA are only $3.25 a bottle!  Easily the best price in town.


Wednesday Night: Brian and Trevor Present Shots! Wednesdays.  It's simple and it's easy. $4 shots of Fireball, Rumchada, Jaeger, and Coldcock.  Ask your bartender if we've added anything else to the list when you come in.  Mix Fireball and Rumchada together and have a few tasty shots from 9pm 'til close.


Thursday Night: Tom and Eloy Present Absolut Thursdays.  Just about everyone loves vodka and Absolut will do you right.  Tom and Eloy will be happy to pour you one of the many flavors we have during our $5 Absolute Thursday promotion - 9pm 'til close.


Friday Night: Busting Draft Beer.  You're in for some fun on Fridays with Brad, Tommy, Jasper, and Eloy and we've got a righteous special for you that night as well.  From 5pm-10pm we have $9 Pitchers of ANY draft beer and $3 glasses of ANY draft beer.  Stella, Blue Moon, Widmer Hefeweizen, Sierra Nevada, Ballast Point Yellow Tail, Bud, Bud Light, and Wyder's Pear Cider.  Fridays go OFF at PECS!


Saturday: Jessie opens the day with Happy Hour Prices until 7pm.  Legendary bartender and beartender Jasper jumps on at 7pm and mans the front with Eloy while Brad and Tommy keep the patio in motion.  Saturdays are not to be missed!


Sunday - Sunday Funday: Eloy and Brad will kick your day off and Brian, Tommy, Jessie, and Trevor will ease you into the evening on Sunday Funday.  Happy Hour Prices until 7pm, FREE hot dogs during the day, and FREE pizza at 9pm!


And don't forget our daytime Happy Hour running from the moment we open 'til 7pm each and every day of the week.  Eddie, Jessie, and Eloy look forward to seeing you here!


Have any questions about our specials or ideas for new ones?  Feel free to chat us up and let us know what you think!  PECS is a part of your neighborhood and you're a part of ours!

Name: El Almacén
Address: Florencia # 37, ZONA ROSA, Distrito Federal, 06600, Mexico
Description:
Celebrating its 23rd anniversary this year, this bar is actually TWO BARS IN ONE: 

On the main floor is “El Almacén”, (The Warehouse). It’s got murals depicting a warehouse décor, playing chill music with an ambiance best for carrying a conversation with friends, new and old alike. Here you’ll find strong drinks and friendly staff in a relaxed atmosphere … The perfect way to start the evening. 

Afterwards, if you’re looking for a place more daring, one with “steamy” parties and cutting-edge electronics, then head down to the lower level and check out their 2nd bar: “El Taller”, (The Workshop). This Bear/Muscle bar attracts the manly testosterone crowd, and is aptly decorated with heavy machinery and tools.

Both bars offer theme pumping parties on weekends including Leather, Uniform and Underwear night, complete with shows and surprise guests. They also offer film screenings on Wednesdays and Sundays.

Overall both of these bars attract the kind of manly guys you’re likely to find in a real tool shed or warehouse. The place is located on the posh Zona Rosa district, amidst fine hotels and near the embassy row. 

One more thing you should know, there's no sign leading to “El Almacen” or “El Taller”, other than a door decorated with nuts and bolts above it … Now that’s exclusive!

Name: Biz horse club @ HORSE SUPPORT CENTER
Address:
〒300–1155　（本社）茨城県稲敷郡阿見町吉原2553–63

厩舎住所　　　〒300-1283　茨城県牛久市　奥原町3693
Description:
■HORSE SUPPORT CENTERとは、セクマイ（Gay)が代表を務めている一般社団法人です。

引退競走馬の価値創造と終生飼養を掲げて、茨城県稲敷郡阿見町を拠点に活動をしています。具体的には馬との触れ合いや乗馬体験をご提供しています。

■引退競走馬問題とは？

競馬産業のもとで、人の手によって生み出された馬たちは、走り終えた後も人間社会の中で、何かしらの役割を見出さなければ馬生を続けることはできません。

繁殖、乗用、ホースセラピーなどのアフターキャリアにおける価値と、食肉としての価値を天秤に掛けることで、次の道が決まるのが現実です。

引退競走馬が活躍する場所や役割が少ないこと、それにより馬が持つ可能性を活かしきれていないことに、もどかしさを感じ、Biz horse clubをスタートいたしました。

■Biz horse clubとは

引退競走馬を終生飼養する上で、その馬の個性と特徴を生かしたオシゴトを創り出し、馬自身が再び経済活動に参加できることを目指しながら飼養管理をする、「Biz horse club」を運営しています。

ビズホース第一号である舞姫は、少しツンデレだけど人に従順であるという特徴から、乗馬やセラピーなどのオシゴトを少しずつこなしながら、独り立ちを目指して奮闘中です。左に曲がった鼻とたまに出ちゃう怪獣みたいな声がチャームポイント♡

ぜひ会いに来てください！

■乗馬&ふれあい
＊馬との触れ合い、引き馬体験、乗馬体験、馬のお手入れ体験
＊ 注意事項：安全の為、弊社スタッフの指示をしっかりと聞いてください。

＊送迎について：最寄りの土浦駅、ひたち野うしく駅、荒川沖駅より代表の藤沢が送迎を行います。＊要予約＊

Name: ge:less(dance lesson)
Address: スタジオをレンタルしての開催となりますので、その時により場所を変更いたします。(基本街中)
Description:
『一緒にダンスを始めてみませんか？』

札幌の大通りを中心に、子どもから大人、初心者から経験者まで、様々な人達にダンスを教えています！

個別でのダンスレッスンが可能なため、平日土日祝、午前中〜夜間まで、ご希望の時間に沿ってレッスンをいたします！⏰
※その日のスケジュールによって、ご希望に添えない場合がございますので、予めご了承ください。

【ge:less】という言葉には、4つの英単語から抜き出した「ge」に、否定の意味を持つ「less」をつけて、ある強い思いが込められています。

まず、「ge」は以下の3つの英単語に由来します：
* Age（年齢）
* Gender（性別）
* Genre（ジャンル）
これらに「less」をつけると、それぞれ次のような意味になります：
* Ageless（年齢に囚われない）
* Genderless（性別に囚われない）
* Genreless（ジャンルに囚われない）
つまり、「何歳だから」「男性だから／女性だから」「このジャンルだから」といった固定観念から自由でいい、というメッセージです。
年齢や性別、ジャンルに縛られることなく、自分の思うままに生きていい。
私は、HIPHOPだろうがJAZZだろうが、とにかく“ダンス”が好きだからこそ、ジャンルに囚われず自由に表現したい。
その想いが、この言葉には込められています。

さらに、もう一つの「ge」は、
* Change（変わる）
ここに「less」をつけると、
* Changeless（変わらない）
という意味になります。
私は過去に、「世間の普通」と「私の普通」が違うという理由で、心無い言葉を投げかけられたり、拒絶されたことがありました。
自分の「普通」が周囲と違うことに悩み、苦しんだ時期もありました。
けれど、どれだけ悩んでも、私の「普通」は変わりませんでした。
そして、変わからなかったその自分を、私は後悔していません。
むしろ、その“変わらない”自分を信じて進んできたからこそ、今の私がいます。
そして私は、そんな自分が大好きです。

「自分」という一人の人間が持つ、個性・思想・素質・生態は、簡単に変わるものではありません。
だからこそ、美しく、尊く、そして面白い。そんな「自分」を愛し、大切にし、尊重してほしい。
その先に、本当の「自分」がきっと見えてくるはずです。
無理に変わらなくていい。 あなたが持っているもの、感じてきたこと、経験してきたことは、すべてあなただけの「普通」。 周囲の「普通」に無理に合わせる必要はありません。 自分自身の「普通」を信じてあげてほしい。 そんな願いを、この言葉に込めました。

以上のことから、
【ge:less】という言葉には、「自由」と「信念」が込められています。

年齢・性別・ジャンル――誰かが決めた枠にとらわれることなく、自分の感じるままに、自分らしく生きていい。
 誰かの「普通」に無理に合わせなくてもいい。
 あなたが歩んできた道、積み重ねてきた想いや経験は、あなただけの価値であり個性です。

自分自身という存在を見失わず、ありのままの自分を選び続けてほしい。 それこそが、本当の意味で“自分を生きる”ということだと、私は信じています。

【ge:less】は、その思いを形にした言葉。

この言葉と共に、一緒に『ダンス』という身体表現を使い、何にも囚われないありのままの自分で踊りませんか？

HIPHOPからJAZZダンスまで、様々なジャンルを教えます🙆

経験者だけでなく、初心者の方も教えていますので、まずはお気軽にInstagramのDMにてお問い合わせいただけますと幸いです📩

1人でも、お友達を誘ってでも構いません。

同じ境遇だからこそ、あなたの【第一歩】を誠心誠意お手伝いさせていただきます。

Name: Woochi Japanese Fusion & Bar
Address: 119 N Michigan St, South Bend, IN 46601
Description:
Located in the heart of downtown South Bend, Woochi Japanese Fusion & Bar is a stylish and vibrant dining destination that blends traditional Japanese flavors with modern fusion creativity. Known for its colorful atmosphere and energetic vibe, Woochi offers an experience that goes far beyond sushi.

The menu features an extensive selection of sushi rolls, sashimi, tempura, teriyaki, and teppanyaki dishes, crafted with fresh ingredients and innovative twists. Guests can also enjoy a wide range of specialty cocktails—including what many locals call the best martinis in Michiana—as well as an impressive tea selection that pairs perfectly with the cuisine.

Whether you’re gathering with friends, celebrating a special occasion, or simply looking for a lively night out, Woochi delivers a mix of flavor, flair, and fun. With its contemporary design, upbeat energy, and diverse menu, it’s a place where both sushi newcomers and seasoned enthusiasts can indulge.
